fields.options:
Add this to your Print Format's HTML, sized to match the Width/Height on the right (in points; roughly px at 96dpi). Recommended minimum: 160x80 - with every stamp field enabled (signer/reason/location/date/certificate serial), that's up to 5 lines of text and needs real room:

<div style="display:inline-block; position:relative; width:160px; height:80px; margin:4px 0;">
  <span style="color:#ffffff; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:0;">##DIGITAL_SIGN_ANCHOR##</span>
</div>

The stamp's bottom-left corner is placed exactly where the anchor text sits, so position:absolute; left:0; bottom:0; pins it to the box's own bottom-left corner. The stamp text is vertically centered within whatever height you give it, so a tall-enough box centers the whole stamp between surrounding lines automatically - the margin above adds a small buffer so it never touches text directly above the box.

Use color:#ffffff (matching the background), not opacity:0 - some PDF engines skip painting opacity:0 text entirely, dropping it from the searchable text layer too. If the surrounding background isn't white, match this color to it instead.
